FAQ

How are payments verified?

Users pay to the displayed UPI ID, submit UTR and screenshot, and an admin manually verifies the request.

Can automatic verification be added?

Yes. A payment gateway/API can replace the manual flow later.

How does support work?

Users can open tickets or contact WhatsApp support.
